title: Article signature verification: X-Usenet-IPFS-Sig + DKIM
description:
Verify cryptographic signatures on inbound articles, accumulate keys, and surface results through NNTP and JMAP.

Why this issue exists:
Articles arrive with signing headers (X-Usenet-IPFS-Sig, DKIM-Signature) but nothing currently checks them. Verification results need to be stored locally and surfaced to readers. Keys accumulate in a local store as articles flow in. S/MIME is schema-reserved for v2 (cert_der column present but unused).

Architecture:
- New usenet-ipfs-verify crate (MIT): VerificationResult types, SQLite ops, both verifiers
- mail-auth (Apache-2.0, Stalwart) for DKIM: handles DNS TXT lookup, canonicalization, RSA+ed25519 verify
- ed25519-dalek (already in tree) for X-Usenet-IPFS-Sig
- Two new tables in core DB: article_verifications + seen_keys (with cert_der reserved)
- Verify at ingest in reader POST path and transit IHAVE/TAKETHIS path; never block on failure
- Synthesize X-Usenet-IPFS-Verified: header on NNTP ARTICLE read (not stored in article bytes)
- JMAP Email/get: x-usenet-ipfs-verifications property
- Group log entry: optional verification_cid pointing to DAG-CBOR attestation block (shared-if-easy)

Failure policy: dns-error, no-key, and fail results are all recorded; article always accepted.
notes: v2 scope: Autocrypt (keydata= OpenPGP key in header) and S/MIME (X.509 cert in MIME body) are both deferred to v2. The seen_keys schema accommodates both: cert_der BLOB for S/MIME X.509, and key_type 'openpgp' for Autocrypt OpenPGP keys. No schema migration needed when v2 lands.
